mapper.sql: id, customer_id, document_type, template_id, version, deleted, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM xsy_customer WHERE id = #{customerId} AND deleted = FALSE)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xsy_print_customer_template (customer_id, document_type, template_id, version, deleted, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{row.customerId}, #{row.documentType}, #{row.templateId}, 0, FALSE, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{row.createdBy}, #{row.updatedBy})
